messages:
incident-bot: Pager received: HIGH - metering.pipeline.consumer_lag > 4h and token_count_delta > 25% for orgs producing high volume. Auto-page to #incidents and oncall rotation. Details: consumer=metering-consumer-3, partition_lag=158k msgs, downstream-aggregation delayed. See /incidents playbook link :rotating_light:

maria-w: acked. I'm on it. putting a short triage here. first-pass: looks like a consumer restart earlier at 02:14 UTC correlates with spike in token delta. billing flags going out for several orgs in the 2:00-3:30 window.

lucas-g: I see the consumer restarted due to OOM, but crashloop stopped after autoscaler bumped nodes. logs show long GC and a backlog of messages that were processed with an older tokenizer version mismatch? weird.

ashok: tagging eng-infra for kernel-level I/O contention possibility @eng-infra. Also pinging @billing-team because there are overage flags firing in prod.

eng-infra: digging into node metrics now. Disk io spiking around restart time, but not saturated. Nitro instance reported higher steal time. Can you dump the consumer config and recent deploy manifest?

maria-w: config and last deploy: ```
# metering-consumer config
replicas: 3
image: redwood/metering-consumer:2026-04-07-rc3
batch_size: 512
commit_interval_ms: 3000
kafka_consumer_timeout_ms: 60000
```

maria-w: quick query against processed tokens table: ```sql
SELECT hour, sum(tokens_processed) as tokens
FROM metering.processed_tokens
WHERE hour >= '2026-04-07 01:00'
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour;
-- results: 01:00: 48M, 02:00: 50M, 03:00: 72M (spike), 04:00: 53M
```

sophie: the 03:00 spike aligns with backlog flush. but token_count_delta > 25% when comparing our live counter vs billing counters. That suggests double-count or duplicate processing during the consumer restart window.

maria-w: my hunch is duplicate commits or reprocessing partitions after a failed offset commit. Let's enable strict offset commit logging and force-run a small targeted reprocess check. Running quick scan for duplicate message IDs now.

lucas-g: also found this in logs around restart: ```
ERROR metering.consumer OffsetCommitFailedException partition=5: commit timeout
WARN metering.consumer Retrying commit for partition 5
INFO metering.consumer Processed message id=abc123 tokens=1024
INFO metering.consumer Processed message id=abc123 tokens=1024
```

ashok: that duplicate pair is a smoking gun. Looks like at-least-once processing triggered duplicates when commit didn't persist and the retry path reprocessed same messages. we need to figure out how many duplicates made it to the billing aggregator before dedup.

maria-w: mitigation plan (live):
1) temporarily pause billing alerting for affected orgs to avoid immediate customer overage emails (billing-team to confirm). :white_check_mark:
2) switch metering-consumer to a fallback dedup-enabled consumer (feature flag) which dedups by message id at write time. this will slow throughput but prevent new duplicates.
3) run a targeted reconciliation job to identify and mark duplicate token entries between 02:00-04:00 UTC.
4) communicate to customers impacted with a holding statement if overages are about to be charged.

billing-team: please hold alerting and auto-charges for the following orgs: org-984, org-1123, org-4400. pausing now. will confirm when safe to re-enable.

eng-infra: we can flip the feature flag for the dedup consumer. rolling update commands ready: ```bash
# roll to dedup consumer image
kubectl set image deployment/metering-consumer metering-consumer=redwood/metering-consumer:dedup-2026-04-07 --namespace=prod
# monitor rollout
kubectl rollout status deployment/metering-consumer --namespace=prod
```

maria-w: executing rollout now. will watch for errors.

oncall-rotation: handoff reminder in 30m for @maria-w -> @lucas-g shift. please leave state in thread.

[~10 minutes later]

maria-w: rollout completed, new pods registered. Observed processing rate drop ~25% but dedup seems to suppress repeated ids in logs. quick sanity grep: ```
grep "Processed message id=" /var/log/metering/consumer.log | grep abc123 | wc -l
# result: 1
```

lucas-g: good. now we need to reconcile historical duplicates. I've started a reconciliation job that scans token writes for duplicate message_id within the affected time window and computes the delta. Running job id reconcile-2026-04-07-1.

lucas-g: job progress: 45% - estimated dedup removals: ~2.8M tokens (approx). If applied, billing adjustments should reduce computed tokens by ~3% across the affected org set.

billing-team: if reconciliation confirms duplicates, we'll issue credits for the net overcount. preparing template customer note draft now.

sophie: quick check on analytics pipeline: delayed aggregated usage reports will affect dashboards for ~6-12h as we re-ingest corrected aggregates. Notifying analytics consumers.

maria-w: immediate action items summary:
- billing-team: hold alerts/charges for listed orgs (acknowledged)
- eng-infra: monitor node I/O and instance steal across the cluster; consider node type migration if recurrence
- eng-runtime (lucas): complete reconcile, provide a delta CSV with per-org adjustments
- devex/sales: prepare customer-facing holding message and credit plan

eng-infra: adding follow-up: we'll snapshot instance metrics and open an infra ticket to investigate host-level preemption/steal. Also checking if kubelet evictions contributed to commit failures.

maria-w: running reconcile result now: ```
reconcile-2026-04-07-1 DONE
duplicate_records_found: 11234
tokens_marked_for_removal: 2818740
preview_sample_org_adjustments:
- org-984: -124k tokens
- org-1123: -34k tokens
- org-4400: -512k tokens
```

billing-team: reviewed preview. looks good. proceed with adjustments and prepare credit notes. Also enabling a guard: don't auto-bill reconciled windows until a manual sign-off.

sophie: dashboards will reflect adjustments after reingest. pushing a low-priority alert to customer success for manual outreach if needed.

maria-w: final wrap: root cause = consumer offset commit retries + at-least-once processing + lack of early dedup before aggregation. Short-term fix: dedup consumer + pause billing for affected orgs + manual reconciliation. Long-term: add exactly-once semantics or idempotent write path for aggregator, and add synthetic tests for consumer restart scenarios.

maria-w: tagging postmortem owners: @lucas-g (reconcile + long-term aggregator idempotency) and @ashok (infrastructure hardening). I'll start postmortem draft after this thread.

lucas-g: took on postmortem action to produce timeline & RCA draft. will circulate within 24h.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to MONITORED state. Severity lowered to MEDIUM after mitigation. Thanks to responders. :heart:

billing-team: re-enabling alerts for non-affected orgs. will leave paused orgs paused until manual sign-off from @maria-w.

oncall-rotation: handoff now: @maria-w -> @lucas-g. all context in this thread. :wave:

maria-w: signing off. leaving watch for 2h. will update postmortem once initial draft is ready.

lucas-g: will monitor reconcile verification and customer comms. ping if anything regresses.

sophie: thanks team. closing thread for active ops; keeping as reference for postmortem.
